recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future tracker asks to further modernize the remaining Stack Overflow or general support-channel guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-38653 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for FHIR-core Basic. It asked to replace the Basic best-practices wording that referred to HL7's FHIR list-server with a link to chat.fhir.org.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 5f531e1e69b9e204655620f7f828574951f04bf2, which changed source/basic/basic-notes.xml from "HL7's FHIR list-server" to an anchor linking to https://chat.fhir.org. Current blame for the relevant line still points to that commit.
additional_context: Basic is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/basic/basic-notes.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-10-17 record the same Persuasive 15-0-0 vote as Jira. Literal Zulip searches for FHIR-38653 and the old/current Basic wording did not find a contrary implementation discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because source/basic/basic-notes.xml already says to post the desired resource type on chat.fhir.org or Stack Overflow.
